title: The Optimist 30A
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at “The Optimist”, a luxury 7-bed, 7.5-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 16 guests, this home offers a Private Pool & Hot Tub, Rooftop Deck Elevator, Peloton & Golf Cart. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights -Resort Style Private Heated Pool (Heating available for an additional $60 per day during the months of Oct 31-May 1) -Hot Tub -Gulf Views -Short Walk to Beach Access -Elevator -Peloton Bike - 6 Adult Bikes Included - 6 seater Golf Cart included Defining the pinnacle of luxury beach living, The Optimist 30A is a magnificent property spanning a vertical footprint of three levels gorgeously accessorized with multiple sunlit porches. Guests will enjoy the most notable amenities of a resort style vacation including seven bedrooms, six and a half baths, a gourmet kitchen with wet bar and wine cooler, private elevator, and breathtaking outdoor living space that will be the epicenter for entertaining and relaxing. On the first level, guests enter the Main Living space with natural light flooding into the pristine open concept design with opulent living space with modern fireplace, dining area, and well-appointed gourmet kitchen. Entertaining is made easy with a Sub Zero 48'' refrigerator, Wolf SS 48'' dual fuel gas range, custom vent hood, convenient pot filler and coffee station. The opulent kitchen island with its waterfall marble countertop provides added seating. Step from this area through gorgeous Euro doors into a large, covered lanai bringing the outdoors in with a lovely transitional area with a resort style pool, incorporated hot tub and waterfall feature that flows into the shallow area with sunbathing ledge. It’s an easy stroll through the pool or swim up to the submerged bar seats that adjoin the bar and sunken outdoor kitchen. The stunning outdoor kitchen comes with a BBQ grill and Big Green Egg, soda cooler, ice maker and sink. After an evening swim, gather by the lovely, modern fire pit. Finally, retreat for relaxation in the Primary King suite featuring doors that open to the lanai and a sumptuous ensuite with a double spa shower and soaking tub. This floor also hosts an additional Queen bedroom (not pictured). Serene colors, calming textures, shiplap accents, designer lighting, and natural wood elements continue throughout the home. The second-floor wraps guests in luxury with three king bedrooms – each featuring its own private ensuite baths. One bedroom includes a small workout room with Peloton. The third and final level of the main house features a capacious Family Room with a queen sleeper, covered porch access, and crisp white Bunk Room featuring two Twin over Twin Bunks with a shared bath/shower combination. Additional details include a personal elevator and ultimate laundry room. Towering above is a sun deck that lets you gaze at breath taking gulf views and sunsets that will forever draw you into the allure of the Gulf. The Optimist 30A embodies the heart of 30A’s coastal experience with excellent proximity to highly coveted world class shopping, dining, and eclectic entertainment for which 30A is known. Sleeping Arrangements First Floor Master Bedroom - King - Private bath with shower and soaking tub Queen Bedroom (not Pictured) 1/2 bath Second Floor King Bedroom - Private bath with Shower King Bedroom - Private Bath with Shower King Bedroom - Private bath with Shower Third Floor Bunk Room - Two Twin over Twin Bunks Shared bath with Shower Family Room - Queen Sleeper Sofa - Shared bath with Shower Carriage House Full Guest Suite & Ensuite Bathroom with SIngle Vanity & Tile/Glass Shower. Plus Kitchenette (dishwasher, microwave & mini Fridge.) *Garage is not for guest use*
